About these 3 rides

They ride on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Sundays. The earliest start is Church of the High Pines Sunday Ride at 11:00 am; the latest is Pedal the Peaks Wednesday Shop Ride at 6:00 pm. After work, 2 roll on a weekday evening. By bike: 2 road, 1 mountain bike and 1 social. All 3 run every week. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Oct 26, 2026.
